payload.title: Resolution changes on real data
payload.description: This notebook explores the effects of resolution changes on marine sediment core U1308 by applying the LERM method. It aims to recreate Figure 8 from a referenced publication. The analysis involves loading oxygen isotope data from Pangaea and performing LERM analysis on the data binned to different resolutions.

steps.description: Import necessary libraries for data processing and visualization. Suppress warnings for presentation purposes.
steps.title: Import Libraries and Suppress Warnings

steps.description: Load the U1308 oxygen isotope data from Pangaea using the PanDataSet class.
steps.title: Load U1308 Oxygen Isotope Data

steps.description: Define a function to detect transitions in the data series.
steps.title: Define Transition Detection Function

steps.description: Apply LERM analysis on the data binned to different resolutions to explore resolution effects.
steps.title: Perform LERM Analysis
